from pathlib import Path
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
e=json.loads(Path('/tmp/expected/expected.json').read_text());v=json.loads(Path('/source/check.json').read_text())
for n,h in e['artifacts'].items():assert sha('/source/'+n)==h
for n,h in e['candidate_hashes'].items():assert sha('/experiment/'+n)==h
for n,h in e['script_hashes'].items():assert sha('/tmp/linkage/'+n)==h
assert e['validation']==v and all(c['exit_code']==0 for c in e['checks'])
assert sha('/tmp/native/report.json')==e['input_hashes']['report_sha256']
r=json.loads(Path('/tmp/native/report.json').read_text())
assert v['records']==len(r['rows'])==3970 and v['points']==sum(x['points'] for x in r['rows'])==r['points']==71891534
assert v['present_empty_returns']==sum(x['points']==0 for x in r['rows'])==15
assert v['annotated_returns']==sum(x['segmentation_present'] for x in r['rows'])==120
assert v['eligible_semantic_points']==9204259 and v['absent_returns']==0
u=v['worker_resources'];assert math.isfinite(u['elapsed_seconds']) and u['elapsed_seconds']>0 and u['peak_rss_kib']>0
Path('/outputs/check.json').write_text(json.dumps(v,indent=2));print('PASS independently retained engineering point/grid linkage')
